chapterInfo.content:
17
Kristo bɔ mpaeɛ ma ne ho
1Yeinom na Yesu kaeɛ, na ɔmaa n’ani so kyerɛɛ soro, na ɔkaa sɛ: Agya, dɔn no adu. Hyɛ wo Ba animuonyam, na Ɔba no nso ahyɛ wo animuonyam, 2#Mat 11.27 sɛdeɛ womaa no honam nyinaa so tumi, sɛ adeɛ biara a wɔde ama no no, ɔmma wɔn daa nkwa. 3#1 Yoh 5.20 Na yei ne daa nkwa, sɛ wɔbɛhu wo, nokorɛ Nyankopɔn koro no, ne deɛ wosomaa no no, Yesu Kristo no. 4Me deɛ, mahyɛ wo animuonyam asase so; mawie adwuma a wode maa me sɛ menyɛ no. 5#Yoh 17.24; 1.1; Flp 2.6 Na afei, Agya, fa animuonyam a mewɔ no wo nkyɛn ansa na wɔbɔɔ wiase no hyɛ me wo ara wo nkyɛn!
Ɔbɔ mpaeɛ ma n’asuafoɔ
6 # Yoh 17.9 Mayi wo din adi makyerɛ nnipa a wode wɔn firi wiase ama me no. Wɔyɛ wo dea, na wode wɔn ama me; na wɔadi w’asɛm so. 7Afei wɔahunu sɛ nnoɔma a wode ama me no nyinaa firi wo nkyɛn; 8#Yoh 16.30 ɛfiri sɛ nsɛm a wode ama me no, mede mama wɔn; na wɔn nso wɔagye, na wɔahunu ampa sɛ, mefiri wo nkyɛn na mebaeɛ, na wɔagye adi sɛ wo na wosomaa me. 9#Yoh 6.37; 6.44 Me deɛ, meresrɛ mama wɔn; mensrɛ memma wiase, na mmom wɔn a wode wɔn ama me no, ɛfiri sɛ wɔyɛ wo dea. 10#Yoh 16.15 Na m’adeɛ nyinaa yɛ wo dea; na wo deɛ nso yɛ me dea; na manya animuonyam wɔn mu. 11#Yoh 10.30 Na afei menni wiase bio, — na yeinom na ɛwɔ wiase, na me deɛ, mereba wo nkyɛn. Agya Kronkron, wɔn a wode wɔn ama me no, fa wɔn sie wo din mu, na wɔayɛ baako sɛ yɛn. 12#Yoh 6.39; Dwom 41.9; 109.8 Mewɔ wɔn nkyɛn no, mede wɔn mesiee wo din mu, wɔn a wode wɔn ama me no; mawɛn wɔn, na wɔn mu bi nyerae, gye ɔyera ba no, — na twerɛsɛm no aba mu. 13#Yoh 15.11 Na afei na mereba wo nkyɛn, na meka yeinom wiase, na wɔanya m’anigyeɛ ama awie pɛyɛ wɔ wɔn mu. 14#Yoh 15.19 Mede w’asɛm mama wɔn; na wiase atane wɔn, ɛfiri sɛ wɔmfiri wiase, sɛdeɛ me nso memfiri wiase no. 15#2 Te 3.3 Mensrɛ sɛ: Yi wɔn firi wiase, na mmom sɛ: Bɔ wɔn ho ban firi ɔbɔnefoɔ no ho. 16Wɔmfiri wiase, sɛdeɛ me nso memfiri wiase no. 17#Yoh 6.63 Yɛ wɔn kronkron wɔ nokorɛ mu; w’asɛm yɛ nokorɛ. 18#Yoh 20.21 Sɛdeɛ wosomaa me wiase no, saa ara na me nso meresoma wɔn wiase. 19#Heb 10.10 Na meyɛ me ho kronkron mema wɔn, na wɔn nso ayɛ kronkron nokorɛ mu.
Ɔbɔ mpaeɛ ma n’akyidifoɔ a wɔbɛba
20 Na ɛnyɛ yeinom nkutoo nti na mesrɛ, na mmom wɔn a wɔnam wɔn asɛm so bɛgye me adie nso nti, 21#Gal 3.28 sɛ wɔn nyinaa nyɛ baako, sɛdeɛ wo, Agya, wowɔ me mu, na mewɔ wo mu; sɛ wɔn nso nyɛ baako wɔ yɛn mu, na wiase nnye nni sɛ wo na wosomaa me. 22#Aso 4.32 Na mede animuonyam a wode ama me no mama wɔn, sɛ wɔnyɛ baako, sɛdeɛ yɛyɛ baako no. 23#1 Ko 6.17 Mewɔ wɔn mu, na wowɔ me mu, na wɔawie pɛyɛ baakoyɛ mu, na wiase ahunu sɛ, wo na wosomaa me, na wodɔ wɔn sɛdeɛ wodɔ me no. 24#Yoh 12.26 Agya, wɔn a wɔde wɔn ama me no, mepɛ sɛ faako a mewɔ no, wɔn nso mmɛka me ho, na wɔnhunu m’animuonyam a womaa me no, ɛfiri sɛ wodɔ me ansa na wɔhyɛɛ wiase ase. 25Agya Tenenee, wiase anhu wo, na me deɛ, mahu wo, na yeinom ahunu sɛ wo na wosomaa me; 26na mayi wo din makyerɛ wɔn, na mɛyi makyerɛ. Na ɔdɔ a wode dɔ me no atena wɔn mu, na matena wɔn mu.

pageProps.chapterText:
Yeinom na Yesu kaeɛ, na ɔmaa n’ani so kyerɛɛ soro, na ɔkaa sɛ: Agya, dɔn no adu. Hyɛ wo Ba animuonyam, na Ɔba no nso ahyɛ wo animuonyam, sɛdeɛ womaa no honam nyinaa so tumi, sɛ adeɛ biara a wɔde ama no no, ɔmma wɔn daa nkwa. Na yei ne daa nkwa, sɛ wɔbɛhu wo, nokorɛ Nyankopɔn koro no, ne deɛ wosomaa no no, Yesu Kristo no. Me deɛ, mahyɛ wo animuonyam asase so; mawie adwuma a wode maa me sɛ menyɛ no. Na afei, Agya, fa animuonyam a mewɔ no wo nkyɛn ansa na wɔbɔɔ wiase no hyɛ me wo ara wo nkyɛn!

Mayi wo din adi makyerɛ nnipa a wode wɔn firi wiase ama me no. Wɔyɛ wo dea, na wode wɔn ama me; na wɔadi w’asɛm so. Afei wɔahunu sɛ nnoɔma a wode ama me no nyinaa firi wo nkyɛn; ɛfiri sɛ nsɛm a wode ama me no, mede mama wɔn; na wɔn nso wɔagye, na wɔahunu ampa sɛ, mefiri wo nkyɛn na mebaeɛ, na wɔagye adi sɛ wo na wosomaa me. Me deɛ, meresrɛ mama wɔn; mensrɛ memma wiase, na mmom wɔn a wode wɔn ama me no, ɛfiri sɛ wɔyɛ wo dea. Na m’adeɛ nyinaa yɛ wo dea; na wo deɛ nso yɛ me dea; na manya animuonyam wɔn mu. Na afei menni wiase bio, — na yeinom na ɛwɔ wiase, na me deɛ, mereba wo nkyɛn. Agya Kronkron, wɔn a wode wɔn ama me no, fa wɔn sie wo din mu, na wɔayɛ baako sɛ yɛn. Mewɔ wɔn nkyɛn no, mede wɔn mesiee wo din mu, wɔn a wode wɔn ama me no; mawɛn wɔn, na wɔn mu bi nyerae, gye ɔyera ba no, — na twerɛsɛm no aba mu. Na afei na mereba wo nkyɛn, na meka yeinom wiase, na wɔanya m’anigyeɛ ama awie pɛyɛ wɔ wɔn mu. Mede w’asɛm mama wɔn; na wiase atane wɔn, ɛfiri sɛ wɔmfiri wiase, sɛdeɛ me nso memfiri wiase no. Mensrɛ sɛ: Yi wɔn firi wiase, na mmom sɛ: Bɔ wɔn ho ban firi ɔbɔnefoɔ no ho. Wɔmfiri wiase, sɛdeɛ me nso memfiri wiase no. Yɛ wɔn kronkron wɔ nokorɛ mu; w’asɛm yɛ nokorɛ. Sɛdeɛ wosomaa me wiase no, saa ara na me nso meresoma wɔn wiase. Na meyɛ me ho kronkron mema wɔn, na wɔn nso ayɛ kronkron nokorɛ mu.

Na ɛnyɛ yeinom nkutoo nti na mesrɛ, na mmom wɔn a wɔnam wɔn asɛm so bɛgye me adie nso nti, sɛ wɔn nyinaa nyɛ baako, sɛdeɛ wo, Agya, wowɔ me mu, na mewɔ wo mu; sɛ wɔn nso nyɛ baako wɔ yɛn mu, na wiase nnye nni sɛ wo na wosomaa me. Na mede animuonyam a wode ama me no mama wɔn, sɛ wɔnyɛ baako, sɛdeɛ yɛyɛ baako no. Mewɔ wɔn mu, na wowɔ me mu, na wɔawie pɛyɛ baakoyɛ mu, na wiase ahunu sɛ, wo na wosomaa me, na wodɔ wɔn sɛdeɛ wodɔ me no. Agya, wɔn a wɔde wɔn ama me no, mepɛ sɛ faako a mewɔ no, wɔn nso mmɛka me ho, na wɔnhunu m’animuonyam a womaa me no, ɛfiri sɛ wodɔ me ansa na wɔhyɛɛ wiase ase. Agya Tenenee, wiase anhu wo, na me deɛ, mahu wo, na yeinom ahunu sɛ wo na wosomaa me; na mayi wo din makyerɛ wɔn, na mɛyi makyerɛ. Na ɔdɔ a wode dɔ me no atena wɔn mu, na matena wɔn mu.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
